newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-LENS PUNISHED OVER BOTTLE INCIDENT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LENS PUNISHED OVER BOTTLE INCIDENT.

text.p: French first division side Lens will have to play one of their next home league matches on neutral ground as punishment for an incident in a match against Paris St Germain earlier this month.
In the 74h minute of the game, won by PSG 2-1, Lens fan Tony Baczkowski, 21, threw a plastic bottle full of water at a linesman. The match was halted for 10 minutes.
The discipline committee of the French National League (LNF) ruled on Thursday that Lens' next home match should be played on neutral ground. Lens have appealed against the decision.
"It is unfair. There were 28,000 decent people in the stadium and just one madcap," said Lens president Gervais Martel.
He claimed Lens should not have been punished since the fan was arrested on an anonymous phone call. He was later sentenced to one month in prison and banned from attending Lens matches for a year.
